summary: Tenon Medical, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting that Nasdaq confirmed it regained compliance with the minimum bid price requirement (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)) after a 1-for-35 reverse stock split. The filing is a routine compliance update with no special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition or restructuring. The only notable corporate action is the reverse split, which was previously announced and is not the subject of this filing. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. Watch for continued Nasdaq listing compliance and potential liquidity impacts.
